faqs.q: What’s included in a deep clean?
faqs.a: It depends on the type of clean and the property, so the room-by-room checklist is agreed with your quote before anything is booked. As a guide, a deep clean goes further than a regular clean: built-up grease, limescale, inside accessible cupboards, skirting, edges and hard-to-reach surfaces. Oven interiors, carpets and rubbish removal are only included if we’ve confirmed them.

faqs.q: Do you provide cleaning products and equipment?
faqs.a: [[Confirm whether all products and equipment are brought to every job, and anything the customer needs to provide]] Gentler products are used wherever they’ll do the job. If anyone in the home has allergies or sensitivities, mention it when you enquire.

faqs.q: How long does a clean take?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the property, its condition and the type of clean, so you’ll get a time estimate with your quote. [[Typical example, e.g. an end-of-tenancy clean of a 2-bed flat usually takes around X hours]]

faqs.q: Can you guarantee I’ll get my tenancy deposit back?
faqs.a: No cleaner can honestly promise that. Deposit decisions are made by your landlord or letting agent and cover more than cleanliness, such as damage and wear. What we can do is clean to the checklist agreed with you, so share the inventory or check-in report if you have it.

Yes. It works best once building work has finished and trades are off site, so dust doesn’t settle again. Tell us what work was done and send a few photos if you can. [[Confirm anything excluded, e.g. rubble removal or paint on carpets]]

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during the clean?
faqs.a: [[Confirm how access works, e.g. meeting on site, key safe, or collecting keys from the agent]]
[[Confirm the towns or postcode districts covered, and whether travel outside them is possible]] Not sure? Send your postcode with your enquiry and we’ll confirm.

Each quote is based on the property’s size, its condition and the type of clean, plus any extras you ask for. There are no set packages. Photos help: send a few on WhatsApp or with the form and the quote will be more accurate.

faqs.q: How should I prepare the property?
faqs.a: [[Confirm preparation, e.g. whether the property should be empty and electricity and hot water left on]]
Send the quote form or a message on WhatsApp. Once you’re happy with the scope and price, we’ll arrange a date. [[Confirm payment terms, e.g. deposit on booking or payment on completion]]
